title: Blow-up test integrals versus normalized ball mass
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Let V = v(M, θ) be a RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U, x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, r > 0 and R ≥ 1 with closed ball B_{rR}(x) ⊆ U. Let φ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ be Borel measurable with 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1 everywhere and φ = 0 off the closed ball B_R(0). Put η := η_{x,r} (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r), Hⁿ := μHE[n], I := ∫_{η(M)} φ(y)·θ(x + r y) dHⁿ(y) and J := r⁻ⁿ ∫_{M ∩ B_r(x)} θ dHⁿ. Then (a) 0 ≤ I; (b) if φ = 1 on B_1(0) then J ≤ I; (c) if φ = 0 off B_1(0) then I ≤ J.
